specific_conditional_use: Before a prospective native-EMC NR4A3-program RNA perturbation experiment, include authenticated cultures whose baseline disease-associated whole-RNA pattern resembles native EMC relative to other sarcoma cultures and native tissues. RNA class/state evidence is one model-selection attribute, not a universal best-model ranking.
value_judgment: This is a potentially useful limited RNA question, distinct from matched-donor retention and fixed target panels. Source/schema gating is justified. A new numerical or publication stage is not yet justified merely by processed-source recovery or availability.
primary_prior_art_boundary: Previously verified PDC comparisons to TCGA other histotypes, native fusion-partner programs and targeted-marker/model discrepancies remain prior art. Adding actual native EMC population references could address a different limited RNA state question; novelty requires a specific unreported comparison and cannot be inferred from a new similarity statistic. Prohibited mechanism paper bodies or sequences were not re-read.

prior_source_review_reused.scope: Existing source identity/assay/paired-versus-population and previously permitted method context only; no fresh RNA values or source-body replay.

permissible_future_result: A condition-specific association with a native-EMC RNA reference may support including that model for the stated baseline transcriptional-state experiment, with source/capture/mixture limits. It does not predict perturbation response, dependency, protein localization, drug efficacy, origin, within-patient heterogeneity or universal representativeness.
current_primary_defeat: Full processed-column-to-source identity and comparator diagnosis/condition/normalization are unresolved. A duplicated label cannot be positionally repaired or silently discarded. All publicly identifiable native models and conditions, overlaps and unavailable assays remain part of coverage.
strongest_alternatives: Generic in-vitro growth/medium/passage/capture state versus a retained disease RNA program
Bulk native stromal/immune admixture versus cultured malignant cells
Different gene-index/capture/annotation and normalization across native TPM, estimated counts and RefSeq TPM
Fusion-partner/specimen/grade/source-year composition and overlapping source models
One library/technical runs versus independent cultures/donors; unknown processed duplicate assignment
future_before_values_requirements: Authenticate every model/control and source condition, with public exact processed-column linkage and ambiguous conditions visibly pending.
Define actual common gene-ID/annotation and assay units from source documentation, not filename or nominal genome alone.
Use matched cultured sarcoma controls and same-source native references to separate generic culture/source effects; preserve all eligible observations and suitable pending-source blockers.

Freeze one RNA class/state endpoint, comparator/gene eligibility, scale/normalization, uncertainty and invalidation rules before count cells or scores. No gene nomination or threshold shift after values.
State an experimental inclusion/measurement decision beyond already published phenotype or marker comparisons, and test the strongest alternative.
Obtain integrating lead review before any new numerical stage; no raw-read/matrix acquisition solely to demonstrate math.
not_universal_prerequisites: Matched tissue from the same donor is not required for a valid population comparison.
Protein, functional or clinical validation is not mandatory for a limited RNA contribution.
No invented minimum effect, sample size or independent replication threshold imposed.
current_stage: NO-GO for numerical outcomes; positive measured-source availability and useful conditional RNA question retained.
no_absence_or_exhaustion: Neither inability to execute this current control map nor known target failures rejects all possible culture/population analyses. Source recovery itself is not a scientific finding.
